title: When the Protocol Falls Revisited
author: Tamsin Zhou
blurb: Tamsin Reyes, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
